title: Appeal Rights of a Ridgecrest Advantage Member Against an Adverse Determination or a Denied Claim Line
content:
A member of a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan, or someone they have appointed in writing, may ask the plan to reconsider an adverse organisation determination or a denied claim line.

### Conditions of record

1. **The filing window is open.** The plan receives the reconsideration no later than the last day of the filing window counted from the date the plan mailed the adverse determination notice. Calendar days are counted from the day after that notice date, every day of the week counts, a reconsideration received on the final day of the window is in time, and full 24-hour periods are never used in place of calendar days. The coverage request records are the authority, read on the reference of the determination the reconsideration is filed against.
2. **Authority to file.** Where someone other than the member is filing, a valid appointment of representative form is on file, or the appointment is not required because the filer is the member's treating provider asking for an expedited reconsideration. The coverage request record is the authority, matched on the reference of that request.

### A reconsideration received late

A reconsideration received after that day is accepted only where the member shows good cause and then only inside the good-cause extension the plan held carries; otherwise it is dismissed as filed after the window and the member is told why.

### Expedition

A reconsideration is expedited where applying the standard deadline could seriously jeopardise the member's life, health or ability to regain maximum function, and a treating provider's request for expedition is always granted.

### What the reconsideration names

The reconsideration names the single determination or claim line it is filed against; one that names none is not dismissed but held while the plan asks the member which decision they mean.

### Where the plan upholds itself

Where the plan upholds its adverse decision in whole or in part the case goes to the independent review entity automatically, and the decision letter tells the member so.

### Grievances

A grievance about how the member was treated is not an appeal and never restarts an appeal window; the two are recorded separately and answered separately.

| Circumstance | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| The reconsideration reaches the plan on the day before the last day of the filing window | In time |
| The reconsideration reaches the plan on the final day of the filing window | In time; that day is inside the window |
| The reconsideration reaches the plan one day after the window closes, with no good cause shown | Dismissed as filed after the window, and the member is told why |
